input: Map out all my credit card due dates

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many cards and which ones are included determines the size and complexity of the task.
Whether this covers just the user or also a partner/household changes whose accounts need to be tracked.
Whether the user already has due dates written somewhere or needs to look them all up affects the starting point.
A time pressure (e.g. an upcoming due date this week) would reprioritise which card to handle first.
The preferred format (spreadsheet, calendar, app, paper) determines how the map is built and maintained.
Whether the goal is just visibility or also setting up reminders/autopay changes what done looks like.
Knowing the immediate next action — logging into each issuer, checking statements, etc. — determines the first concrete step.

gold.taskTitle: Map out all credit card due dates
gold.taskDescription: Organise all credit card payment due dates into a clear, usable reference so the user never misses a payment.

questions.title: How many credit cards do you need to track?
questions.description: Establish the total number of cards in scope so the plan scales appropriately.

questions.title: Is this just for you or a partner too?
questions.description: Determine whether accounts belonging to other household members need to be included.

questions.title: Do you already know your due dates or need to look them up?
questions.description: Identify the starting point — existing knowledge vs. research required across issuers.

questions.title: Is any payment due very soon, within the next few days?
questions.description: Flag urgency so the most time-sensitive card can be prioritised first.

questions.title: Where do you want the due dates to live — calendar, spreadsheet, or app?
questions.description: Pin down the format and tool so the output is immediately usable for the user.

questions.title: Should this include setting up reminders or autopay as well?
questions.description: Clarify whether the end goal is passive visibility or active payment automation.

questions.title: Do you have online access to all your card accounts right now?
questions.description: Confirm the immediate next action is feasible — logging in vs. locating paper statements.
